description: Run the site's applicable audit rules on 1–5 URLs that belong to that site's domain, and return per-rule verdicts (pass / warn / fail / na) with the checker detail for each URL. Narrow the set with rule ids when you only care about a few checks. Read-only: it never writes an audit run or flips finding state, and it does not diff against history — use audit_url for the before/after diff. Requires the audit:read scope and counts one network fetch per URL.

rules.description: Optional rule ids to check (default: every rule that applies to the page). Ids that do not apply come back in notApplicable.

siteId.description: Site under this API key; supplies the rule set and the allowed domain.

urls.description: 1–5 http(s) URLs on the site's domain. Duplicates are checked once.

name: check_url
title: Run a site's audit rules on up to 5 URLs
